**Introduction to Minol Acid and Chemicals P. Ltd.**

Minol Acid and Chemicals P Ltd. is a prominent chemical manufacturing and trading company based in **Baroda (Vadodara), Gujarat, India**. Situated at **102 Sudhan Apartment, Opposite Tejas School, Race Course, Baroda-7**, the company has established itself as a reliable supplier of high-quality industrial chemicals, serving a diverse range of industries across Gujarat and beyond. With a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Minol Acid and Chemicals P Ltd. has carved a niche in the competitive chemical marketplace.

The company specializes in the production, distribution, and supply of a wide array of **acids, solvents, specialty chemicals, and industrial reagents**, catering to sectors such as **textiles, pharmaceuticals, dyes, fertilizers, water treatment, and metal processing**. Leveraging Gujarat’s strategic industrial hub status, Minol Acid and Chemicals P Ltd. benefits from excellent connectivity, logistics, and access to raw materials, ensuring timely deliveries and cost-effective solutions for its clients.

Backed by **state-of-the-art infrastructure, stringent quality control measures, and a team of experienced chemists and industry experts**, the company adheres to national and international safety and environmental standards. Whether supplying bulk chemicals to large-scale manufacturers or customized solutions to small and medium enterprises, Minol Acid and Chemicals P Ltd. prioritizes **reliability, purity, and technical support**.

With a customer-centric approach and a reputation for ethical business practices, Minol Acid and Chemicals P Ltd. continues to expand its footprint in the chemical industry, contributing to India’s growing industrial and economic development. The company’s location in **Baroda—a key industrial city in Gujarat—further enhances its ability to serve domestic and export markets efficiently**.
